name: Bifrost
description: Bifrost is an AI gateway with a unified API for multiple model providers. It provides a web dashboard, virtual keys, usage budgets, request logs, load balancing, and automatic fallbacks.

notes.text: Find the generated BIFROST_ADMIN_PASSWORD in /opt/bifrost_data/.env inside the container. Add provider credentials and create virtual keys in the dashboard.
Use an HTTPS reverse proxy for access beyond a trusted network. Authentication is enabled for both the dashboard and inference API.
Keep a backup of /opt/bifrost_data, including .env. Losing or changing BIFROST_ENCRYPTION_KEY makes stored provider credentials unreadable.
